question: Who among the following is also known as 'Punjab Keshari'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lala Lajpat Roy**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Lala Lajpat Rai is known as "Punjab Kesari", which means "Lion of Punjab".
 
• He was a prominent figure in the Indian independence movement and a key player in the fight against British colonial rule. 
 
• some other things about Lala Lajpat Rai:
 
• He was a member of the Lal Bal Pal trio. 
 
• He was a founding member of the Punjab National Bank, established in 1894. 
 
• He founded the Dayanand Anglo-Vedic school in Lahore in 1885. 
 
• He established the Indian Home Rule League of America in New York in 1917. 
 
• He established the Servants of People Society in Lahore in 1921. 
 
• He participated in rallies against the Jallianwala Bagh Massacre, the Rowlatt Act, and the partition of Bengal.
